final_topology.title: Government Isolated Network
final_topology.description: A network for government operations with isolated sensitive systems and secure administration workstations.
final_topology.topology_summary: The network will consist of separate zones for standard and sensitive information, with dedicated management workstations and a secure internet gateway for the standard environment.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Management System' (n_new1) that manages various nodes and zones, indicating an asset inventory system.

controls.title: Document Data Flows
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Data Flow Documentation' server (n_new2) that documents data flows between various nodes and zones.

controls.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
controls.evidence: The topology includes separate zones for 'Standard Environment' (z1), 'Sensitive Environment' (z2), and 'Non-Production Environment' (z4).

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Server Firewall' (n_new3) in the 'Standard Environment' (z1).

controls.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Server' (n9) in the 'Standard Environment' (z1) and links to various nodes, indicating DNS traffic management.

controls.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'MFA Gateway' (n_new4) in the 'Standard Environment' (z1) and links to the 'Secure Gateway' (n3).

controls.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Filter' (n10) in the 'Standard Environment' (z1) and links to the 'Standard Router' (n6).

controls.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Web Proxy' (n11) in the 'Standard Environment' (z1) and links to the 'Standard Router' (n6).

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
controls.evidence: The topology includes separate zones for different environments and security levels, with firewalls and routers managing traffic between them.

controls.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'IaC Management' server (n_new5) in the 'Secure Management' zone (z_new3) and links to the 'Standard Firewall' (n1).

controls.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'AAA Server' (n12) in the 'Management Workstations' zone (z3) and links to various nodes.

controls.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Remote Access VPN' (n_new7) in the 'Standard Environment' (z1) and links to the 'Penetration Testing Host' (n17).

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'NIDS' (n13) in the 'Standard Environment' (z1) and links to the 'Standard Router' (n6).

controls.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
controls.evidence: The topology includes firewalls (n1, n2) and routers (n6, n7) that manage traffic between different zones (z1, z2, z4, z5).

controls.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Remote Access Control' (n_new6) in the 'Standard Environment' (z1) and links to the 'Penetration Testing Host' (n17).

controls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'SIEM' (n14) in the 'Standard Environment' (z1) and links to the 'NIDS' (n13) for log collection.

controls.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
controls.evidence: The topology includes separate zones for 'Standard Environment' (z1) and 'Non-Production Environment' (z4).

controls.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Penetration Testing Host' (n17) in the 'External Testing Zone' (z5) and links to the 'Standard Router' (n6) and 'Pen Test Documentation' (n_new8).

findings_before.title: empty_zone_without_node
findings_before.missing_reason: Zone z4 has no concrete node assigned to it.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add one representative concrete node in this zone and connect it with node_links to the nearest hub, firewall, router, or management/security node.

findings_before.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
findings_before.evidence: The topology shows various nodes and zones, but does not explicitly indicate an inventory system or process for maintaining an up-to-date inventory of all enterprise assets.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of an inventory system or process.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing an asset management system and links to all other nodes.

findings_before.title: Document Data Flows
findings_before.evidence: The topology does not provide explicit evidence of documented data flows.
findings_before.missing_reason: No documentation or labels indicating data flow documentation.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add documentation nodes and links indicating data flow documentation.

findings_before.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes firewalls but does not show firewalls specifically implemented on servers.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add firewall nodes on server nodes.

findings_before.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
findings_before.evidence: The topology does not provide explicit evidence of MFA for remote network access.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add MFA nodes and links to remote access points.

findings_before.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
findings_before.evidence: The topology does not provide explicit evidence of securely managing network infrastructure, such as version-controlled IaC or secure network protocols.
findings_before.missing_reason: No evidence of secure management practices.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add nodes and links indicating secure management practices.

findings_before.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
findings_before.evidence: The topology does not provide explicit evidence of remote devices utilizing a VPN and connecting to the AAA infrastructure.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add VPN nodes and links to remote access points.

findings_before.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
findings_before.evidence: The topology does not provide explicit evidence of managing access control for remote assets.
findings_before.missing_reason: No access control nodes or links for remote assets.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add access control nodes and links for remote assets.

findings_before.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes a Penetration Testing Host (n17) but does not provide explicit evidence of periodic external penetration tests.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add documentation or nodes indicating periodic external penetration tests.
